notes.topic_selection: User rated cat/dog source A 80% and requested a catchier, easier-to-imitate refinement; continue this topic.
notes.production_direction: English song for ages 2–4; two learning words cat/dog; clear lively rhythmic hook; no lip sync; original composition.
notes.visual_reuse_plan: New cat/dog educational scenes for the new topic; reuse approved Momo dance/clap and character assets.

suno_generation.recommendation_basis: Official listening: A clear friendly female lead and natural musical ending, but long outro needs edit. B has long mid-song gaps and abrupt ending. Not a user take selection.

user_feedback_20261106.preserve_direction: Source A is the basis; changing the voice is not requested.
user_feedback_20261106.download_preflight_disposition: Earlier A download approval request is superseded by the requested revision; do not download or claim approval.
user_feedback_20261106.recommendation_basis: Official automatic listening rated take 1 as clearer and less rushed, with a more stable repetitive hook; take 2 has variable woof counts, denser phrases and busy fills. Local waveform and user preference not yet checked.

alignment_review.reason: Whisper turbo loops on highly repetitive sung syllables. Short chunks recover CAT/DOG but inconsistent meow/woof counts remain. Do not claim the 95% lyric gate passed.
alignment_review.production_gate: Full lyric QA and exact transition refinement remain before final render; visual source plan can be reviewed independently.
